units: <cite ref="Ketubot 61b:7">Keth. 61ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Makkot 21a:13">Macc. 21ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 52b:5">Nidd. 52ᵇ</cite>. <he>אמר ר׳ מ׳ אמר ר׳ וכ׳</he> Rab M. reports in the name of R. Ada &c.; <cite ref="Beitzah 28b:14">Bets. 28ᵇ</cite> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).

Ib. (mnemonical rules by which to distinguish between the subjects reported by R. Malkia and those by R. M’lakhiu); ib. וסימנך מתניתן מַלְכִּתָא and the mnemotechnical mark is: the Mishnah is queen, i.e. all opinions referring to Mishnah (and Boraitha) belong to Rab Malkiya (God is King).
